messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Automatic paging: High tail latency detected on streaming endpoint /v1/stream-chat (client_mode=JSON). p95 ~ 390ms (normal ~70ms), p99 ~ 1.1s. Streaming append error rate +4.1%. Alert time 2026-03-14T18:07:03Z. Severity S3.

lia: oncall here, acknowledged. Starting triage. Paging SRE + infra.

kevin: seen this from synthetic monitors too. Traces show first chunk fine then long gap (~800-1200ms) before subsequent tokens. Likely preproc stall.

rafa: support reports AlphaLaw customers getting partial transcripts and IO timeouts. Ticket AL-509 created; they're escalated.

olivia: quick fleet check: preproc-json pool CPU spiking 90% on 4/8 nodes, request queue depth rising. No container restarts. Logs show long time in prompt construction and tokenizer.

```
2026-03-14T18:05:41.231Z preproc-json[pid=201] INFO render start req=zz
2026-03-14T18:05:41.239Z preproc-json DEBUG inject tools schema len=1600 chars
2026-03-14T18:05:41.571Z preproc-json WARN render took=332ms
2026-03-14T18:05:42.041Z preproc-json ERROR tokenizer encode waited=810ms
```

kevin: we rolled a change earlier today (PR #5007) that switched JSON streaming callers to inline full tool schemas for richer tool invocation. That increases prompt expansion significantly for some integrations.

lia: immediate mitigations proposed: 1) temporary truncate tool schema insertion for streaming routes, 2) scale preproc pool, 3) route heavy customers (AlphaLaw) to regional fallback or non-enriched path. Who can flip the truncate flag?

olivia: I can flip truncate. Running: `curl -XPOST https://admin.internal/api/flags -d '{"flag":"truncate_tool_schema","route":"/v1/stream-chat","value":true}'`

ops-bot: Flag update recorded: truncate_tool_schema=true for /v1/stream-chat (ok). AuditID=audit-181000-1.

support-bot: Notifying AlphaLaw: "We're investigating streaming interruptions and applying a temporary mitigation. You may see improved behavior shortly."

kevin: scaling preproc: `kubectl scale deploy/preproc-json -n prod --replicas=6` (from 3).

eng-sre-bot: scale output: deployment.apps/preproc-json scaled; pods starting.

olivia: after truncate flag and scaling, micro-metrics: p95 dropped from ~390ms -> ~95ms, p99 from ~1100ms -> ~260ms on canary pods. Still observing a tail for some long prompts.

kevin: profiler snapshot attached: https://internal.gist/xyz789 showing hot stacks: render_template -> serialize_tool_schema -> tokenize.encode -> gc.collect. Looks like repeated serialization + large string temporaries cause GC pauses.

lia: recommend a two-track fix: A) short term revert/invalidate expensive schema inlining (rollback PR #5007) or keep truncate flag until rollback; B) implement cached-serialization and streaming encoder to avoid large intermediates. Who owns code change?

rafa: support note: AlphaLaw sees restoration on some clients after truncate flag. They're asking for ETA.

kevin: revert is fastest path. I'll open revert PR and run through CI. Revert ETA ~ 15 minutes including canary. Permanent fix ETA ~ 4 hours for initial implementation + perf tests.

olivia: I'm also going to add a circuit-breaker rule in front of preproc: if single-request preproc time > 500ms then return lightweight fallback without enrichment. Will push rule via traffic-layer.

ops-bot: Traffic rule updated: circuit-breaker preproc_timeout_ms=500 route=/v1/stream-chat.

eng-sre-bot: revert PR #5011 created. CI started.

kevin: meanwhile adding interim traffic-split: 30% -> stable-lite variant: `trafficctl set /v1/stream-chat stable-lite=30`.

eng-sre-bot: traffic rule applied. Monitoring fallbacks.

lia: CI green on revert PR. Merging to canary.

eng-sre-bot: canary shows quick improvement: p95 ~ 82ms p99 ~ 200ms on canary. Starting rollout.

rafa: AlphaLaw confirms streams recovered for users routed off enriched path.

lia: logging action items: 1) Kevin: implement cached serialized tool schema (LRU, key=sha256(schema), TTL 10m) + unit tests (INFRA-1199). 2) Olivia: add circuit-breaker and traffic-layer guard permanently (SRE-720). 3) Neha (cc): add tokenizer telemetry and alerts for token counts >512. 4) Support: send final customer communication after postmortem.

kevin: opened INFRA-1199 with initial prototype and benchmark numbers (saw 3x reduction in encode time for repeated schemas). Requesting code review. ETA for merge ~3h.

olivia: will formalize circuit-breaker rule and add dashboard.

support-bot: prepared customer follow-up draft: "We applied mitigation and rolled back an enrichment change that caused prompt expansion. We're building a permanent fix and will share postmortem."

lia: handing off oncall to kevin at 2026-03-14T18:30:00Z. Kevin, you own follow-up and postmortem.

kevin: ack, taking over. I'll coordinate postmortem and notify affected customers when ready.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260314-213 created and status set to MONITORING. Mitigations applied; service restoring.

lia: final note: add a regression test in CI simulating heavy tool schema for streaming to catch this before future rollouts. Kevin please include test in INFRA-1199.

kevin: will do.

ops-bot: Audit: flag toggle + traffic-split + revert PR merge logged.

olivia: closing: we'll keep this monitored for next 24h and prioritize caching and encoder work.

support-bot: AlphaLaw ticket AL-509 updated with mitigation summary.

incident-bot: Incident moved to "post-incident" pending writeup.
